examples.purpose: Linked accounts, the guide's In context: an Accounts title, then each linked account as a tile with the add tile last. Each onPress is the screen's own action (open the account, or start linking a new one). Each tile gets Figma's 125 px where it is placed; the app supplies the card art, since the package ships none.
examples.jsx:
<VStack>
  <Title title="Accounts" subtitle="Linked to JioFinance" />
  <HStack>
    <AccountCard
      title="Joint account"
      subtitle="**** 4821"
      imageSource={require('./card.png')}
      onPress={() => {}}
      style={{ width: 125 }}
    />
    <AccountCard
      state="add"
      title="Add account"
      onPress={() => {}}
      style={{ width: 125 }}
    />
  </HStack>
</VStack>

from.quote: The Accounts screen shows each linked account as a tile, with the add tile last.

props.name: state
props.description: Visual variant of the card. - `'connected'` (default): renders a card preview image, a `title` and a `subtitle` below it (e.g. account name + masked number). - `'add'`: renders an empty placeholder field with a centred `+` icon and only the `title`. Use this for the "Add new account" affordance that pairs with a list of connected `AccountCard`s. Default "connected", from the component source.

props.name: title
props.description: Title rendered below the image / placeholder. Default "Personal account", from the component source.

props.name: subtitle
props.description: An empty subtitle ('' or null) is hidden. Declared: Subtitle rendered below the title (e.g. masked account number). Only displayed when `state === 'connected'`. Default "**** 5651", from the component source.

props.name: imageSource
props.description: With no imageSource (and no cardSlot), a connected tile shows an empty art box. Declared: Card preview image. Only used when `state === 'connected'` and `cardSlot` is not provided. Accepts a URL string or any `ImageSourcePropType` (e.g. `require('./card.png')`).

props.name: imageRatio
props.description: Aspect ratio (width / height) of the image / placeholder area. Defaults to the Figma reference ratio (`125 / 82` ≈ `1.524`). Default 1.5244 (125 / 82), from the component source.

props.name: cardSlot
props.description: cardSlot replaces the art or the add field in either state, and gets the tile's modes. Declared: Override the entire image / placeholder area with a custom node (e.g. a smaller `DebitCard`, a brand logo, a remote image). Receives `modes` automatically through `cloneChildrenWithModes`.

props.name: addIcon
props.description: Icon name shown inside the "Add" placeholder. Defaults to `'ic_add'`. Only used when `state === 'add'`. Default "ic_add", from the component source.

props.name: onPress
props.description: Press handler. Applied to the whole card so the entire surface is a single touch target — particularly important for the `'add'` state, which behaves like a button.

props.name: disabled
props.description: disabled sets the tile to 0.5 opacity with or without onPress; with onPress it also stops presses (aria-disabled on the web). Declared: Disable interaction (also dims the card). Default false, from the component source.

props.name: modes
props.description: The tile reads modes only from its modes prop; it ignores JFSThemeProvider. Declared: Design token modes (e.g. `{ 'Color Mode': 'Light' }`).

props.name: accessibilityHint
props.description: On the web accessibilityHint is dropped. Declared: Accessibility hint forwarded to the underlying `Pressable`.

props.name: disableTruncation
props.description: disableTruncation lets the title and subtitle wrap. Declared: When `true`, disables text truncation: the trailing ellipsis (`…`) is never shown and any `numberOfLines` clamp is ignored, so the text wraps to as many lines as it needs even when horizontal space is tight.

modes.name: AppearanceBrand
modes.description: A token collection AccountCard reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.
